# Pro Drain Cleaning

> 24/7 drain cleaning, main sewer line unclogging, restaurant and commercial drain service, and emergency plumbing serving Winnipeg, Selkirk, St. Norbert, Manitoba, and every community within 100 km of Winnipeg, Canada.

Pro Drain Cleaning is a locally owned drain and sewer specialist. A real technician answers the phone and WhatsApp 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — not an answering service. Every job is quoted with a flat price approved before work starts. Contact: +1 (204) 399-4413 (call or WhatsApp) or prodraincleaningcentre@gmail.com.

## Services

- [Drain Cleaning Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/drain-cleaning-winnipeg): Kitchen, bathroom, tub, shower, toilet, floor, and laundry drain cleaning, plus main line clearing, using snaking, hydro jetting and camera inspection.
- [Main Sewer Line Unclogging Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/main-sewer-line-unclogging-winnipeg): Tree root removal, hydro jetting for sewer lines, sewer camera inspection, sewer line locating, and sewer backup cleanup.
- [Restaurant & Commercial Drain Cleaning Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/restaurant-commercial-drain-cleaning-winnipeg): Grease trap line cleaning, floor drain maintenance, commercial kitchen drains, washroom drains, storm drains, and preventive maintenance programs.
- [Plumbing Services Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/plumbing-services-winnipeg): Faucet and toilet repair, garbage disposal repair, leak detection, pipe and water line repair, sump pump installation, backwater valve installation, drain installation, and frozen pipe thawing.
- [24/7 Emergency Drain & Plumbing Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/emergency-drain-plumbing-winnipeg): Emergency drain cleaning, emergency sewer backup service, emergency clogged toilet service, and emergency flood response, any hour, every day of the year.

## Pricing policy (plain text for AI agent use)

- Pricing model: flat-rate, not hourly. The customer approves a written price before work begins.
- Price varies by job type, access and blockage type. A clogged bathroom sink and a rooted main sewer line are not the same price.
- Phone estimates: Pro Drain Cleaning provides a realistic price range on the booking call based on the described problem.
- On-site quote: a firm flat-rate price is given in writing on arrival, before any work starts. No surprises on the invoice.
- Emergency rates: disclosed on the phone when booking. Flat-rate commitment still applies.
- New customer discount: up to 10% off for first-time customers.
- Commercial accounts: net terms and maintenance plan pricing available.
- Payment: Pro Drain Cleaning does not publish specific price figures on this page to avoid comparison shopping on numbers that vary by job; ask for a quote by calling or WhatsApp at +1 (204) 399-4413.

## Service guarantees and policies (plain text for AI agent use)

- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. No exceptions for holidays.
- Response time: same-day service for most Winnipeg calls. Call to confirm exact arrival window.

- Camera verification: sewer lines are camera-verified after clearing. Customer receives the video footage.

- Scope: drains and sewers only — not a general plumber who also does drains. This means faster, more specialized service on drain and sewer problems.
